threat_event: Ransomware encrypts the on-premises data center, endpoints, and directory, forcing EHR downtime, loss of clinical servers, and ambulance diversion
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Standing domain administrator rights (31 accounts); 14 vendor VPN accounts without MFA; flat clinical VLAN; on-premises recovery never tested; backup appliance joined to the directory
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-05; SYS-06; SYS-07; SYS-08; BP-01 to BP-11
existing_controls: MFA for remote access, email, and cloud; EDR with 24x7 MSSP; write-once cloud backups in a separate account; EHR vendor DR tested annually
treatment_plan: Vendor access platform for all vendors with MFA; privileged access management for all admin planes; remove backup appliance from the domain; IT DR plan and quarterly restore tests; campus segmentation; 72-hour downtime tabletop 2026-11-10

threat_event: Exfiltration of PHI for extortion before or during a ransomware attack (double extortion)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No egress volume alerting; data warehouse and file services logs not in the SIEM; 6 analysts can export full patient-level extracts
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-04 data warehouse and file services; SYS-01 extracts
existing_controls: EDR; SIEM on identity, EHR audit, cloud, firewall; MFA
treatment_plan: Egress alerting on the cloud firewall; data warehouse and file services logs to the SIEM; export approval for patient-level extracts
exposure_estimate_usd: $4M-$9M (up to 310,000 individuals notified; counsel, forensics, call center, credit monitoring, regulatory)

threat_event: On-premises clinical servers (LIS, dispensing cabinet, pump, monitoring gateway, fetal surveillance, cardiology) cannot be restored within the BIA RTO after an outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No IT disaster recovery plan; no application-level restore ever tested; two servers backed up only by their vendors to local disks
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-05; BP-02; BP-03; BP-05 to BP-08
existing_controls: Nightly backups to the appliance with write-once cloud copy; vendor support contracts
treatment_plan: IT DR plan from the BIA; bring vendor-run backups into the appliance; quarterly restore tests (interface engine 2026-10-20, then LIS, cabinet server, PACS)

threat_event: Attacker with domain administrator rights deletes or encrypts local backups on the backup appliance before replication
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backup appliance joined to the hospital directory; backup administrators also domain administrators
existing_controls: Write-once cloud copy in a separate account with separate credentials
treatment_plan: Remove the appliance from the domain; separate backup administrator credentials; alert on backup job deletion

threat_event: EHR vendor outage lasts beyond the clinical MTD (4 hours), forcing diversion and prolonged paper operations
threat_source: EHR vendor infrastructure failure or vendor-side cyber incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor RTO 12 hours versus BIA RTO 2 hours; downtime procedures tested only to 4 hours
existing_controls: Vendor alternate hosting site; hourly downtime extracts to 12 workstations
treatment_plan: Recovery terms at renewal; 72-hour downtime procedures; quarterly downtime drills per unit

threat_event: Paper downtime procedures fail beyond 4 hours: orders, medications, and results are lost or duplicated, harming patients
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2022 procedures; never exercised beyond 4 hours; most staff hired since 2023 have not practiced
treatment_plan: Rewrite procedures for a 72-hour outage; unit drills each quarter; downtime kits; back-entry rules

threat_event: Attacker or malware moves from a workstation to patient monitors, analyzers, cabinets, or the cath lab system on the shared clinical VLAN, disrupting or altering device function
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared clinical VLAN (gap 1); inventory 70% complete; no device network monitoring
existing_controls: Pumps and imaging on their own VLANs; EDR on workstations
treatment_plan: Passive device discovery and monitoring; device VLANs with deny-by-default rules for monitors, analyzers, cabinets, fetal monitoring, and the cath lab

threat_event: Known vulnerabilities in 210 unsupported-OS medical devices are exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Unsupported operating systems; manufacturer patches unavailable; compensating controls only for imaging
treatment_plan: Compensating controls per device class (VLAN, allowlisting); replacement plan in the 2027-2029 capital budget; 524B procurement terms

threat_event: Attacker takes over a domain administrator or vendor service account and controls the directory, servers, and backups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 31 domain administrator accounts with standing rights, 12 of them vendor service accounts; privileged access management only in the cloud; no MFA for on-campus admin sign-in
existing_controls: Separate admin accounts for most IT staff; SIEM alert on new domain admins
treatment_plan: Privileged access management for directory, IdP, EHR, PACS, LIS, and network; phishing-resistant MFA for admins; vault and rotate service account passwords

threat_event: Attacker uses a device vendor's persistent VPN account without MFA to enter the clinical network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 14 vendors on persistent VPN accounts without MFA or session recording (gap 5)
existing_controls: 32 vendors already on the vendor access platform
treatment_plan: Move all 14 vendors to the access platform with MFA, approval, and recording; disable persistent VPN accounts

threat_event: Phishing steals workforce credentials, leading to mailbox access, payroll diversion, or PHI exposure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 6.9% phishing click rate; push MFA without phishing resistance for most users
existing_controls: MFA with number matching; email security gateway; quarterly simulations
treatment_plan: Targeted training for repeat clickers; payroll change verification by phone; impossible-travel alerts

threat_event: Attackers spoof the hospital's email domain to defraud patients, vendors, or the affiliated practices
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: DMARC at p=none; external sender tagging off (gap 12)
treatment_plan: DMARC to quarantine then reject; external sender tags

threat_event: A departed contracted clinician, agency nurse, or affiliated practice user keeps EHR access and views or misuses PHI
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Non-employee accounts have no end dates; agencies and practices report departures late; 19 stale accounts in July 2026 (gap 8)
regulatory_driver: C-HPH-R01 (164.308(a)(3)(ii)(C)); C-HPH-R08 (CPG Essential: Revoke Credentials for Departing Workforce Members)
treatment_plan: End dates on all non-employee accounts; monthly reconciliation with agencies and practices; quarterly access reviews

threat_event: A workforce member looks up a high-profile patient's record without a work reason, and the access is not detected until the media reports it
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: EHR access monitoring covers only VIP-flagged records and employees' own records (gap 7); VIP flag set manually
existing_controls: Break-the-glass on VIP records; sanctions policy; annual training
treatment_plan: Behavior-based EHR access analytics; monthly review; automatic VIP flag on admission of public figures; second P08 runbook

threat_event: An attacker or a careless change alters the infusion pump drug library or dispensing cabinet profiles, causing dosing errors
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No integrity monitoring on the pump server; shared vendor local administrator password (P07)
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-05 pump and cabinet servers; SYS-08 pumps; BP-06
existing_controls: Pumps on their own VLAN; pharmacist approval of library changes; bedside barcode verification
treatment_plan: Integrity alerts on library changes; restricted admin access; vendor password changed

threat_event: Compromise of building OT through the automation vendor's shared portal credentials or the flat campus network disrupts HVAC, isolation room pressure, or blood bank temperatures
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT shares the IT network at the main campus (gap 13); vendor cloud portal with shared credentials; no OT monitoring
regulatory_driver: C-HPH-R07 (42 CFR 482.15(b)(1)(ii)(A)); C-HPH-R08 (CPG Enhanced: Network Segmentation)
existing_controls: Local controllers continue in manual mode; facilities engineers on site 24x7
treatment_plan: OT network segment; named vendor portal accounts with MFA; weekly configuration export; OT asset inventory

threat_event: A network-wide outage takes down VoIP and clinical smartphones, so codes, alarms, and diversion calls are delayed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: VoIP and smartphones depend on the campus network; analog lines and radios only in the ED and house supervisor office
existing_controls: Overhead paging on a separate amplifier; EMS radio in the ED
treatment_plan: Analog or cellular lines on every unit; handheld radios for codes; quarterly communications drill

threat_event: A cyber event activates the emergency plan without cyber hazards, strategies, or diversion criteria, producing a disorganized response and a survey deficiency
threat_source: Structural gap in the emergency plan
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Hazard vulnerability analysis ranks IT outage as short and low (gap 2)
existing_controls: Mature hurricane and mass-casualty program; Hospital Incident Command System
treatment_plan: Cyber hazards and an IT outage annex in the plan; tabletop 2026-11-10

threat_event: Diversion during an IT outage is decided or communicated poorly, and an ambulance patient is turned away improperly
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No IT-outage diversion criteria; diversion status communicated only by phone and radio
existing_controls: County EMS protocol; ED Medical Director on site 24x7
treatment_plan: Diversion criteria and script in the P08 runbook; log every diversion decision

threat_event: Clearinghouse outage stops claims and eligibility for more than 72 hours
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single clearinghouse
treatment_plan: Secondary clearinghouse connection; cash-flow playbook

threat_event: A vendor handling PHI without a BAA suffers a breach, and the hospital cannot enforce notice or safeguards
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 42 of about 210 PHI vendors have no BAA (gap 6)
existing_controls: BAAs with 168 vendors including all Tier 1
treatment_plan: BAAs for the 42 vendors or stop PHI flows; purchasing gate

threat_event: A Tier 1 vendor's controls degrade after onboarding and the hospital does not notice
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendors reviewed only at onboarding (gap 6)
treatment_plan: Annual review of the 15 Tier 1 vendors (P09)

threat_event: Compromise of the MSSP or EHR vendor's tooling is used to push malicious changes or access PHI at scale
threat_source: Nation-state or cybercriminal group targeting a supplier
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MSSP agents on all endpoints; EHR vendor administrative access
existing_controls: Vendors' SOC 2 Type 2 reports; contract notice terms
treatment_plan: Annual SOC 2 and CUEC review; limit MSSP response rights to containment

threat_event: The sepsis prediction model misses septic patients or floods nurses with false alerts, delaying treatment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Live since 2025-11 without local validation, threshold review, or owner (gap 9)
treatment_plan: Local validation; universal screening; threshold decision by the Clinical Decision Support Committee (P10)

threat_event: The sepsis model performs worse for some patient groups (it uses age as an input), creating discrimination risk under Section 1557
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No 92.210(b) identification or mitigation record; no subgroup monitoring
treatment_plan: 92.210 identification and mitigation record; quarterly subgroup monitoring (P10)

threat_event: The imaging triage software misses a stroke or hemorrhage, or a reader relies on it to deprioritize a study
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No local performance monitoring; no subgroup data from the manufacturer
existing_controls: FDA clearance; radiologists read every study
treatment_plan: Quarterly discordance and subgroup monitoring; reading policy (P10)

threat_event: The ED ambient scribe records patients or companions without all-party consent
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot started without a consent process or notice
treatment_plan: Notice, consent script, EHR consent field, monthly audit (P10)

threat_event: The scribe vendor uses hospital audio or transcripts to train its models beyond what the BAA allows
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor standard BAA permits de-identified use
treatment_plan: BAA amendment: no training, 7-day audio deletion

threat_event: Staff paste PHI into public generative AI tools that have no BAA
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No approved enterprise tool; 214 staff used public tools in July 2026 (gap 9)
existing_controls: Acceptable use policy (2023) silent on AI
treatment_plan: Block public tools on the web proxy except an approved enterprise assistant with a BAA; POL-05 AI rules; training

threat_event: Coding assistance suggests unsupported codes that are billed, creating overpayments
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Coders accept suggestions without sampling
regulatory_driver: 45 CFR 92.210 not applicable (not clinical); payer program integrity rules
treatment_plan: Monthly 50-claim audit; acceptance thresholds (P10)

threat_event: PHI in the interface engine test environment is exposed to analysts or vendor engineers without a need
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Production PHI copied into test (gap 11)
treatment_plan: Synthetic or de-identified test data; purge existing copies

threat_event: A laptop is lost or stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 960 laptops and workstations in use
treatment_plan: Encryption makes the data secured under breach guidance; accept

threat_event: An internet-facing VPN or firewall vulnerability is exploited before it is patched
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Edge devices patched quarterly unless a critical alert arrives
treatment_plan: Patch internet-facing devices within 7 days of a known-exploited listing

threat_event: Critical vulnerabilities stay open beyond target dates
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Quarterly scans; critical findings average 41 days
treatment_plan: Monthly scans; 14-day internet-facing and 30-day internal targets (STD-09)

threat_event: A cloud storage or database setting exposes PACS images or warehouse data to the internet
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Guardrails block public storage; data warehouse endpoints reviewed manually
treatment_plan: Add a guardrail for database public endpoints

threat_event: An authorized analyst exports large patient-level data sets from the data warehouse and misuses or mishandles them
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Full-extract rights for 6 analysts without approval; warehouse logs not in the SIEM
treatment_plan: Export approval workflow; warehouse logs to the SIEM

threat_event: An intrusion through the LIS, a clinical server, a medical device, or OT goes undetected for weeks because those systems send no logs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Monitoring blind spots (gap 7)
treatment_plan: SIEM onboarding of on-premises clinical servers and the interface engine; passive device and OT monitoring

threat_event: An affiliated practice user's credentials are phished and used to browse hospital patient records
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Practice devices unmanaged; practice users not trained; broad shared-patient access
treatment_plan: Restrict practice roles to their own patients plus referrals; practice user training; device requirements checked

threat_event: The hospital misses its 8-hour practice restoration commitment after an EHR outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Commitment never tested
treatment_plan: Include practice access in the DR test plan

threat_event: Servers and network devices drift from secure configuration
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No configuration standard for network devices and vendor-managed servers (gap 10); 23% of sampled settings out of baseline
existing_controls: Gold images for workstations and servers
treatment_plan: Issue STD-01; monthly drift reports

threat_event: Activity under generic accounts on ED tracking boards, nursing displays, and analyzer workstations cannot be attributed to a person
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Generic and shared accounts
treatment_plan: Kiosk mode with no PHI search; named accounts on analyzer workstations

threat_event: Someone enters one of 9 keyed network closets and taps or damages the network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Keys with no log
treatment_plan: Badge readers on 9 closets

threat_event: Hard drives in imaging, ultrasound, or leased equipment leave with PHI because the vendor gives no sanitization certificate
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 4 of 6 returns lacked certificates
treatment_plan: Sanitization certificate required before any device leaves

threat_event: A hurricane cuts power, carriers, or cooling to the campus data center for more than 24 hours
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: On-premises clinical servers have no alternate site
existing_controls: Generator with fuel plan; two carriers; hurricane plan
treatment_plan: Document data center hurricane procedure; test carrier failover

threat_event: Data center cooling fails and servers shut down
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Redundant cooling with alerting
treatment_plan: Within appetite given redundancy

threat_event: Both outpatient center SD-WAN links fail
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two carriers
treatment_plan: Within appetite

threat_event: An interface mapping error files laboratory results to the wrong patient
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 12 patient-matching errors from the reference laboratory interface in 2026; no matching validation
treatment_plan: Patient-matching validation rules; second reviewer for mapping changes

threat_event: PHI is faxed or emailed to the wrong recipient
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manual fax numbers
existing_controls: Cloud fax with saved numbers; training
treatment_plan: Saved recipients only; outbound email encryption prompt

threat_event: A patient portal account is taken over
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Portal MFA optional
treatment_plan: Promote portal MFA

threat_event: Image routing to the teleradiology or telestroke service is abused to reach the PACS
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Persistent image-routing connections
treatment_plan: Restrict routing to named destinations; review in the annual vendor review

threat_event: The 3-person security team and part-time vCISO cannot run the program, MSSP oversight, vendor reviews, and SOC 2 at once
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Key-person dependency; no GRC tooling
treatment_plan: Fund a GRC analyst and vendor-risk tooling

threat_event: A breach notice deadline (Florida 30 days, HIPAA 60 days) is missed because discovery and determination dates are not captured
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Decision log missing in 3 of 9 privacy incidents
treatment_plan: Decision log with discovery and determination dates (P08)

threat_event: The HIPAA Security Rule NPRM is finalized and raises requirements before the program is ready
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Proposed only (90 FR 898)
existing_controls: Roadmap already moves toward the proposals
treatment_plan: Track; roadmap aligned

threat_event: Attackers use default or shared vendor credentials found on clinical servers and devices (found in P07)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: The pump and cabinet servers share one vendor default local administrator password; 4 of 20 sampled devices accepted default credentials
existing_controls: Pumps and cabinets segmented from the internet
treatment_plan: Change all default and shared vendor passwords; vault them; add a default-credential check to device onboarding

threat_event: A clinical smartphone with secure messages is lost
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 380 shared smartphones
existing_controls: MDM encryption, passcode, and remote wipe
treatment_plan: Encrypted and wiped; accept
